summary: CWE-379 fix: the bad() method created a temporary file inside a predictable, world-accessible shared directory (C:\testcases\insecureDir or /home/user/testcases/insecureDir/) via File.createTempFile(prefix, suffix, insecureDir), exposing its contents to other local users. The fix creates the temporary file with java.nio.file.Files.createTempFile, which places it in the JVM's secure per-user temporary location and (on POSIX) restricts permissions to the owner (rw-------), while still writing the same data and performing the same cleanup. The write is also no longer gated on the insecure-directory creation succeeding, so legitimate functionality is preserved.
